Overview
The Mark-10 WT-205M Motorized Wire Crimp Pull Tester is engineered for precision, consistency, and automation in wire crimp testing. With programmable test speeds, automatic cycling, and pass/fail logic, this robust tester is designed to meet the demands of both production floors and quality control labs. It supports UL, ISO, ASTM, SAE, and MIL testing standards, including UL 486A/B requirements for pull-to-load, pull-to-break, or load-hold tests (optional).
Its multi-slot adjustable fixture supports wires up to AWG 3 (0.25 in / 6.3 mm), and the self-tightening wedge grip ensures repeatable clamping. Optional interchangeable grips extend testing capabilities to a wider range of materials. Mark-10 offers free sample evaluations to help recommend the right grip setup.
The WT-205M features an intuitive display with real-time and peak force measurements, red/green pass/fail indicators, audio alerts, and high-speed automatic functions including sample break detection, auto-reverse, and auto-zeroing. It stores up to 2,000 data points with optional date/time stamps and includes MESUR Lite software for data analysis and one-click Excel export.
With the ability to save and recall up to 500 test profiles (optional), and seamless output via USB, RS-232, Mitutoyo, or analog, the WT-205M streamlines repetitive testing and ensures compliance with rigorous standards.
 Back
Features & Benefits
Motorized Testing: Delivers up to 200 lbF [1,000 N] with selectable speeds, automatic cycling, and auto-start upon sample insertion.
Industry-Compliant: Supports UL, ISO, ASTM, SAE, and MIL testing methods, including UL 486A/B pull and hold tests (optional).
Automated Testing Workflow: Auto-reverse, auto-zero, and auto-output upon sample break improves efficiency and repeatability.
High-Capacity Memory: Stores up to 2,000 readings with statistical analysis and optional date/time stamps for full traceability.
Advanced Fixture Compatibility: Standard multi-slot fixture fits AWG 3 wires; optional grips accommodate a broader material range.
Visual and Audible Indicators: Programmable red/green lights and alarms notify operators of pass/fail status instantly.
Profile Management: Save and recall up to 500 test profiles (optional), reducing setup time across varying test scenarios.
MESUR Lite Software Included: View, analyze, and export test results via an easy-to-use PC interface.
Secure Settings: Password protection blocks unauthorized changes to test configurations.
Flexible Output Options: Includes USB, RS-232, Digimatic, and analog outputs for integration with QC and SPC systems.

Frequently Asked Questions
What differences does WT-205M have from the WT-205?
The WT-205M is a motorized tester, offering automated pull-to-load, pull-to-break, and load-hold testing with programmable speeds and profiles—ideal for high-repetition environments.
Can the WT-205M run tests automatically without operator intervention?
Yes, the tester features auto-start upon sample insertion, auto-reverse on break, and automated data capture, making it highly efficient for production environments.
What wire sizes and types can the WT-205M test?
The standard fixture accommodates wires up to AWG 3 (0.25 in / 6.3 mm). Optional grips are available for alternative sizes or specialized materials.
Does the unit support storing and exporting test results?
Yes. The WT-205M stores up to 2,000 test results and exports data via USB, RS-232, Digimatic, or analog. Optional time/date stamps are available for full traceability.
Is software included with the WT-205M?
Yes, MESUR® Lite is included. It allows real-time monitoring, data logging, and simple Excel export for further analysis.
